//: Do NOT add compilerOptions.paths here. Expo's Metro reads this file's paths as real runtime aliases, so a typecheck-only alias (e.g. pointing 'react' at @types/react to dedupe JSX types) resolves at bundle time too and breaks the build. The duplicate-React-types problem it was working around is instead solved by keeping @types/react on one version across the monorepo, so npm hoists a single copy.
